parameters.toolDescription: Search interview stories, STAR examples, behavioral answers, and tech stack cheat sheets from the personal knowledge base. Use this whenever the user asks about interview questions, behavioral examples, leadership stories, technical background, or needs help practicing their answers.

query.description: The interview question or topic to search for. Examples: 'leadership', 'conflict resolution', 'system design', 'failure story', 'tell me about yourself'

mode.description: Which section of the knowledge base to search. Use 'all' if unsure.
